meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 它会先克隆 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现来确认根因,再判断缺陷属于哪个仓库,最后用 gh 创建一个英文 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可提 PR),内含复现步骤、根因与修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或归类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发;根因和复现路径明确后才会真正提单。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug 提一个 issue
say.note: 会先调查根因再决定归属仓库

say.text: 这个 bug 在干净的 Codex CLI 上也能复现,帮我提 PR
say.note: 只有 openai/codex 能建 PR

say.text: 先查一下有没有人报过这个错误,别重复
say.note: 会搜索已有 issue 并追加证据评论

howto.what_en: It clones the LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, runs a minimal reproduction to confirm the root cause, decides which repo owns the defect, then files an English GitHub issue via gh (PRs only for openai/codex) with repro steps, root cause and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin or upstream Codex CLI bug; it only files once the root cause and reproduction path are concrete.

say_en.text: File an issue for this LazyCodex installer bug
say_en.note: Investigates the root cause and picks the repo first

say_en.text: This bug also reproduces on clean Codex CLI, file a PR
say_en.note: Only openai/codex can get a PR

say_en.text: Check whether this error was already reported first
say_en.note: Searches existing issues, then comments evidence
